🎮 Backlog Quest (“LogQue”)

The more you use Backlog, the more your character grows.

An achievement-driven RPG where your everyday task work turns straight into experience points. Fully released and on by default — turn it off anytime from the Options screen if you'd rather not use it.

⚔️

Choose from 8 classes

A wide variety of 8 distinct classes

⬆️

Level Up & Titles

Earn experience points by logging in, completing tasks, and commenting. Your title evolves every 10 levels, and your companion pet levels up right along with you

🛡️

Your avatar changes with your gear

Collect weapons, armor, helmets, and shields across 11 to 12 tiers each. Equip them and see your look update instantly

🐲

Boss Battles & Hidden Bosses

A boss appears every 10 levels — meet the conditions and a hidden boss shows up too

Your real actions become experience points, as they happen

Earn experience points and gold for consecutive logins, creating/editing/completing tasks, and posting comments or thank-you notes

Level up to grow your title and stats

Attack, Defense, Speed, and HP are shown on a radar chart. Your title evolves every 10 levels

Collect gear to change your avatar's look

Collect weapons, armor, helmets, and shields across 11 to 12 tiers each. Buy them in the shop, equip them, and your avatar updates instantly

Boss Battles, Hidden Bosses, Achievements & Daily Quests

Boss battles every 10 levels come with animated effects. Hidden bosses, achievement badges, and daily quests are all included

An Evolving Companion Pet

A companion pet evolves right alongside you. You can name it and switch up its look too

See the whole team's activity at a glance in the Raid tab

Raid bosses per project/milestone and the team leaderboard, all in one tab. A "Today's Recommended Actions" digest also makes what to do next obvious at a glance

Turn task work into an adventure.

Logging in, completing tasks, and posting comments all turn straight into experience points. Just use Backlog as usual, and your character grows.

Backlog My Tasks

A Chrome extension that lets you check and manage your assigned Backlog tasks across multiple spaces in one place. 8 views and a project dashboard make daily task management and team progress tracking easier.
